text: ひろい　ところで　Ｂボタンを　おすと　はやく　はしれます！

structure.en: if you press the B Button

structure.jp: はやく　はしれます！

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing always follows. Ｂボタンを　おすと = 'if you press the B Button'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing はしる to はしれる turns 'run' into 'can run'. はやく　はしれます = 'you can run fast'.
